query: SELECT ab.id, ab.bidAmount, ab.status, ab.paymentStatus, ab.paidAt, ab.dealerId, c.make, c.model, c.year FROM auctionBids ab JOIN cars c ON ab.carId = c.id WHERE c.make LIKE '%Ford%' AND c.model LIKE '%Mustang%' AND ab.status = 'won' ORDER BY ab.createdAt DESC LIMIT 5;
